summary: Standard Lithium Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with exhibits including an NI 43-101 technical report on a maiden inferred resource estimate for its Franklin Project in Texas, plus consents and a material change report. The filing is a routine disclosure of technical resource information for a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation corporate event. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, or other special-situation activity is indicated. The filing updates resource data and incorporates exhibits by reference into registration statements.
